_note: Educational demo only. These rules are simplified and are NOT medical advice.

rules.description: Fever with cough suggests a respiratory issue
Sneezing with a runny nose points to nasal irritation
Nausea with vomiting suggests a digestive issue
Respiratory symptoms plus aches and tiredness fit the flu
Respiratory symptoms plus loss of smell fit COVID-19
Nasal symptoms plus sore throat fit a common cold
Nasal symptoms plus itchy eyes fit hay fever / allergy
Digestive symptoms plus diarrhoea fit a stomach bug
Possible COVID: take a test and limit contact
Allergy: an antihistamine may help (ask a pharmacist)
Stomach bug: rest and keep hydrated
Breathing difficulty always needs medical attention
Fever + headache + stiff neck is a red-flag combination
